title: How to Crack Competitive Exams with 60 Days of Timed Mock Practice
author: Warish Raj · Founder & Mentor
summary: Discover the 3-phase revision framework that helped thousands of aspirants improve their test scores from 50% to 85%+.
content:
Preparing for national competitive exams like SSC, Banking, Railways, or State PSC requires more than just reading books. High scorers separate themselves through targeted mock practice.

### 1. The Error Log Habit
Never complete a mock test without analyzing every incorrect answer. Write down why you missed it: was it a conceptual gap, a calculation error, or poor time management?

### 2. Time-per-Question Rule
In exams like SSC CGL or Banking Prelims, spending more than 60 seconds on any single reasoning question can derail your entire section. Practice skipping smartly.

### 3. Subject-wise Weak Spot Drills
Use Result Darpan's topic tests to isolate and drill weak areas. If geometry is hurting your quant score, spend 3 days doing only geometry sets before taking another full mock.

title: Last Month Revision Roadmap for General Awareness & Static GK
author: Warish Raj · Result Darpan Team
summary: A high-yield checklist covering Indian Polity articles, Modern History timelines, and the top current affairs topics for upcoming tests.
content:
General Awareness is the biggest score multiplier because questions take less than 15 seconds to answer.

### High-Yield Static GK Topics
- **Indian Polity:** Fundamental Rights (Articles 12-35), Directive Principles, President & Governor powers, Constitutional Amendments.
- **Geography:** Major river systems, National Parks, Biosphere reserves, Mountain passes.
- **History:** 1857 Revolt to 1947 Independence movement landmarks, Governor Generals, Congress sessions.

### Monthly Current Affairs Strategy
Focus on the last 6 months of awards, summit locations, sports championships, and government schemes.
